Common Questions & Answers

We understand you want reliable information while protecting your privacy. To help you make the most of our trusted search service, we've compiled answers to the most common questions about our people search platform.

What is AnyWho?

AnyWho is a people search tool that aids in finding public information about individuals in the US. In moments, AnyWho can sift through billions of public records sourced from thousands of outlets to guide you to the necessary data in a single report.

Why can't I find a person?

If a person isn't found in our directory, potential explanations include: our listings are exclusive to US residents, our directory excludes minors, and certain individuals utilize our opt-out service to conceal their information.

How do I use AnyWho? What information is available?

You can input a name, phone number, email address, or street address to gather insights about an individual, property, or unfamiliar contact. Our searches offer a swift, straightforward approach to uncovering a person's contact details, location, as well as the existence of social media profiles, marital status, and additional information.

Why should I choose AnyWho?

AnyWho enables you to access the latest available information. Our searches deliver prompt and refreshed results, allowing you to conserve time and concentrate on what truly counts.

Do you guarantee 100% accuracy?

Data on individuals undergoes continuous updates, and we cannot guarantee 100% accuracy. Nevertheless, we employ rigorous algorithms to analyze the data, striving to provide you with the best results possible.

Are my searches private?

Your searches are secure and confidential. Rest assured, the individual you're searching for on AnyWho will not be alerted to your inquiry.

What types of information will I get access to on AnyWho?

When accessible, AnyWho can assist you in locating information such as phone numbers, email addresses, current addresses, location histories, family members, marital statuses, social profiles, property ownership details, and additional data.

Can I Use AnyWho for Employment Background Searches?

No, AnyWho is not classified as a consumer reporting agency under the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). You must refrain from utilizing this website to make determinations regarding employment, tenant screening, or any activities governed by the FCRA.

Is AnyWho legal?

All information supplied by AnyWho is sourced from publicly accessible outlets. You could obtain all the data we offer independently by directly accessing these sources. AnyWho simplifies this process by gathering, consolidating, and presenting the information to you in a single, user-friendly report.
